refs.q: *ospfd* must acquire interface information from *zebra* in order to function.

atoms.tpl: Context: FRR separates protocol daemons from the routing manager — ospfd must acquire interface information from zebra in order to function, so zebra must run first.

refs.q: This route is installed into zebra if following conditions are satisfied:

atoms.tpl: Decision: routes are installed through zebra, not independently into the kernel — a route is installed into zebra when its conditions are satisfied.
Consequence: in the fused slice this materializes as 111 cross-service ZAPI flows converging on svc:zebra, which handles 94 message types.
Consequence: svc:bgpd publishes zapi:ZEBRA_ROUTE_ADD and svc:zebra handles it — the route-install path the docs describe.
Provenance: decision statements are authored from FRR documentation; quotes are validated verbatim by the verifier, consequences are measured graph facts.
